subject: code for squashing margins, internal left axes

messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: code for squashing margins, internal left axes
parts:
I put an example on Rpubs of taking the output of a plot created with
facet_grid(), removing superfluous axes, and squashing the vertical
panel margins. If the ggExtra package still existed, I would ask that
it be included there ...

This could fairly easily be tweaked to squash bottom axes/margins
instead, or in addition to, left axes/margins ...

http://rpubs.com/bbolker/3420

Ben Bolker
